works.title: Experiments with Alternate Currents of Very High Frequency (New York, 1891)
works.source: The Inventions, Researches and Writings of Nikola Tesla · ed. T. C. Martin, 1894 · Project Gutenberg #39272 · public domain
works.note: Delivered at Columbia College, New York, May 1891 — his first great demonstration lecture: high-frequency currents, wireless light, and the energy of the ether.

works.title: Experiments with Alternate Currents of High Potential and High Frequency (London, 1892)
works.source: The Inventions, Researches and Writings of Nikola Tesla · ed. T. C. Martin, 1894 · Project Gutenberg #39272 · public domain
works.note: Delivered before the Institution of Electrical Engineers, London, February 1892 — the lecture that made his reputation across Europe.

works.title: On Light and Other High Frequency Phenomena (Philadelphia & St. Louis, 1893)
works.source: The Inventions, Researches and Writings of Nikola Tesla · ed. T. C. Martin, 1894 · Project Gutenberg #39272 · public domain
works.note: Delivered at the Franklin Institute and the National Electric Light Association, 1893 — his most wide-ranging lecture, from the nature of light to wireless transmission.

works.title: The Inventions, Researches and Writings of Nikola Tesla — complete
works.note: Martin’s 1894 compilation: the polyphase-motor papers and all the lectures.
